name: io.github.nonchan7720/manifold
title: Manifold
description: MCP gateway aggregating MCP servers and OpenAPI/Swagger REST APIs behind one MCP endpoint

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the Manifold configuration file into the container

config_path.description: Absolute path to your config.yaml on the host

environmentVariables.name: ENCRYPT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key used to encrypt stored tokens (generate with: openssl rand -base64 32)

environmentVariables.name: SERVER_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Name of a backend server defined under mcpServers in config.yaml; forms the MCP endpoint path /mcp/{SERVER_NAME} (not read by the container itself)
